catholic-encyclopedia-1913-albert-stoeck: This 1913 reference article on Albert Stoeckl — the German historian of philosophy. Friedrich Lauchert praises his textbooks. His history guided Catholic students. The schools learned the past from him. A philosopher's faithful chronicler. His handbooks served the seminaries. His history ran through many editions.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-maurus-von-sc: This 1913 reference piece on Schenkl — the Benedictine scholar. Michael Ott honors his famous works. His pen served the Bavarian schools. The order prized its learned son. The eighteenth century knew his name. His 1816 death is famed. His 1816 works are famed.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-WRKL_WRKL: Harold Weisberg wrote to the news director of WRKL on July 28, 1966, addressing station staff member George Deere. Part of the letter concerns sales of Weisberg's books on the Kennedy assassination. In 1966 his first attacks on the Warren Report were new, and he promoted them himself. The letter shows a self-published author asking a small station for attention.
